# TCG Collection

TCG Collection is an unofficial, local-first Pokémon Trading Card Game collection tracker.

## Primary page

- [TCG Collection](https://theglu3guy.github.io/tcgcollection/): Search the multilingual card catalog, manage a collection and wishlist, create custom lists, track sets, and view Pokédex progress.

## Data

Card metadata and images are provided by [TCGdex](https://tcgdex.dev).

## Usage

Personal collection data is stored only in the visitor's browser. This project is not affiliated with The Pokémon Company.
